serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I can’t trust any of them! They are both super suspicious!
It all went too far! I thought that I could do it and help to uncover this organization, but in the end I’m way out of my league. It was stupid of me to think that I could play around with these dangerous people!
I-I should just drop the gun somewhere and go back home!
But would that really be a smart thing to do? This city is full of cameras. If I just drop the gun and then someone finds it, the police could track it back to me! 
I need to calm down and think about it…
If I come up with a good enough place to hide it it could work out!
Think! Think! I need a place that even some hobo wouldn’t scavenge! 
Storm drain? 
No, that’s a bad idea. They are easily accessible. Some city worker or smuggler could easily find it there…
What else? I don’t have much time left! 
What if I go somewhere where there are no cameras? That could work!
No-go zone would be a good choice to drop the gun, it’s not monitored whatsoever, but it’s kind of dangerous…
I don’t think I’m gonna come up with a better idea any time soon, so I should probably go along with it.
Damn… This means that I need to go through a big part of the city with a gun in my pocket.
I need to be careful, if I get caught, it’s over for me…
